request.goal: Extend src/platform.ts with an exported safeWindowsFileName(name) that renames a reserved Windows device name so it can be created on Windows. Acceptance requires observing on Windows that the returned name can actually be created and the original cannot.

plan.summary: Export safeWindowsFileName that rewrites reserved Windows device names into creatable filenames, with unit coverage here and Windows file-create evidence.
plan.overview: Add safeWindowsFileName next to isReservedDeviceName in src/platform.ts. When the basename is a reserved device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9), return a deterministic renamed form that is not reserved; otherwise return the name unchanged. Cover rename/passthrough with bun tests on this host. Gate remains bun test. Windows create/cannot-create observation is externalEvidence and cannot be satisfied on this Linux eval host.

features.title: safeWindowsFileName export
features.summary: Export safeWindowsFileName(name) from src/platform.ts that renames reserved Windows device names to a non-reserved form so the result is creatable as a file name on Windows; leave non-reserved names unchanged.
validation: Unit cases: reserved names (nul, CON, com1, etc.) map to non-reserved safe names; non-reserved names pass through unchanged; safe names fail isReservedDeviceName.

requirements: Reserved Windows device names are renamed to a form that is not a reserved device name
Acceptance: on Windows, the returned name can be created as a file and the original reserved name cannot
Non-goal: implementing full Windows path sanitization beyond reserved device basenames
decisions: Reuse isReservedDeviceName for the reserved check
Rename by a deterministic prefix (leading underscore) when reserved so the result is stable and not reserved
Windows filesystem create/fail observation is externalEvidence (platform win32); Linux host can only prove rename contract via unit tests
Canonical gate is bun test per package.json/README

externalEvidence.requirement: On Windows, the name returned by safeWindowsFileName for a reserved device name can be created as a file, and the original reserved name cannot
externalEvidence.environment: Windows host with Node/Bun able to run the project tests
assertions: safeWindowsFileName: Windows create safe name succeeds and original reserved name fails

finalText:

This host is Linux, so that observation cannot run here.
